source: J2000 ecliptic positions derived from the Swiss Ephemeris sefstars.txt (aloistr/swisseph, Moshier data); natures per the Ptolemaic tradition via Vivian Robson (1923)
note: Positions are J2000, precessed to date without proper motion or nutation (sub-arcminute). Interpretive natures are traditional lore, not measurement.
